play.title: Galaxy map
play.noWorlds: No worlds have been published yet.
play.noWorldsHint: Check back later, or ask your teacher.
play.gateReady: You have every map shard — the Gate of Time is ready!

error.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.CONFLICT: This clashes with an existing item. Use a different name or order.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
error.AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session is invalid. Please sign in again.
error.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this.
error.ROLE_REQUIRED: This area is not available for your role.
error.QUESTION_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED: This question type is not supported yet.
error.QUESTION_OPTION_COUNT: Each question needs between {min} and {max} options.
error.QUESTION_OPTION_EMPTY: An option is empty. Each option needs text or an image.
error.QUESTION_OPTION_NO_ID: An option is missing its identifier.
error.QUESTION_OPTION_DUPLICATE_ID: Two options share the same identifier.
error.QUESTION_OPTION_DUPLICATE_TEXT: Two options have the same text — students cannot tell them apart.
error.QUESTION_NO_CORRECT_ANSWER: You have not marked a correct answer.
error.QUESTION_CORRECT_DUPLICATE: An option is marked correct twice.
error.QUESTION_CORRECT_NOT_IN_OPTIONS: The correct answer points to an option that no longer exists.
error.QUESTION_ALL_OPTIONS_CORRECT: If every option is correct there is nothing to ask.
error.QUESTION_NO_GAP: There are no blanks yet. Use “+ Blank” to add one.
error.QUESTION_TOO_MANY_GAPS: A question can have at most {max} blanks.
error.QUESTION_GAP_DUPLICATE: Two blanks share the same number.
error.QUESTION_GAP_NO_ANSWER: Blank {gap} has no answer — every response would be marked wrong.
error.MEDIA_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED: This file format is not supported.
error.TIMEOUT: The server did not respond. Check whether the API is running.
error.QUESTION_IN_USE: This question is used by a stage. Remove it from the stage before deleting.
error.CHAPTER_HAS_STAGES: This chapter still has {stageCount} stages. Delete them first.
error.STAGE_HAS_RUNS: This stage already has {runCount} play sessions. Deleting loses that history.
error.ADVISOR_QUEST_REQUIRED: Every stage keeps exactly one NPC quest. You can rename it or change its questions, but not remove it.
error.ADVISOR_LOCKED: You have to clear the NPC quest before this one opens.
error.ADVISOR_QUEST_EXISTS: This stage already has an NPC quest. A stage keeps exactly one.
error.IMPORT_FILE_UNREADABLE: Could not open the file. It must be a real .xlsx and not password-protected.
error.IMPORT_SHEET_MISSING: The file has no Questions sheet.
error.IMPORT_HEADER_MISSING: No header row found carrying quest_code, question_order, answer_type and question_content.

player.seek: Jump to a point in the audio

promptKind.label: How the question is asked
promptKind.textHint: The question text is shown as usual.
promptKind.audioHint: Students hear an audio clip. The question text becomes the transcript, hidden behind a button.
promptKind.noAudio: No audio file yet. Until you upload one, students will simply read the question text.
promptKind.showTranscriptHint: Off by default — listening first is the whole point. The button is always there either way, so a student who cannot make it out can still read along.

new.title: Start a new exercise
new.subtitle: Pick the question type that fits what you want to ask.
new.moreSoon: More types (matching, reordering, speaking, essay) are coming in later batches.

type.mcqDesc: Students pick one or more correct answers
type.gapFillDesc: Students type the missing word into the blank
type.dropdownDesc: Students choose the right word from a dropdown
type.shortAnswerDesc: The learner types a sentence; graded against a list of accepted wordings.

bank.title: Question bank
bank.emptyHint: Use “New question” to add the first one.

editor.explanationHint: Shown to students after they submit
editor.previewHint: This is exactly what students will see.
editor.tryItHint: Scored by the server, exactly as it will be for students.
editor.saveFirst: Save the question first to try grading.

builder.sentenceHint: Type the sentence, put the cursor where you want a gap, then press “+ Blank”.
builder.acceptedHint: List every wording that should count as right. Capitals, punctuation and extra spaces are ignored — no need to list those variants.
builder.shuffleNote: Students will see the answers shuffled.
builder.sentencePlaceholder: For example: hello there, my name is Nam

import.title: Import questions from a spreadsheet
import.hint: An .xlsx file from the content team, with a Questions sheet. Rows matching an existing quest code are attached to that quest; the rest stay in the bank, keeping their codes.
import.missingQuests: No quest carries these codes yet. Put the code on a quest in the designer, import again, and they attach themselves:

list.title: Worlds
list.subtitle: Pick a world to build its chapters and stages.
list.emptyHint: Run the seed to create the sample world Lost in Atlantis.

detail.noStage: This chapter has no stages yet.
detail.noChapterHint: Run the seed to create the 5 chapters of Lost in Atlantis.
detail.confirmDeleteChapter: Delete this chapter? Only possible when it is empty.
detail.publishWorldHint: Students only see a world once it is published.
detail.worldCodeHint: For future content files. No file uses it yet, so empty is correct.

characters.title: Characters ({count})
characters.hint: Players pick one of these when they enter this world.

field.name: Stage name
field.starScorePctsHint: Percent of the stage's max score for each star, e.g. 40, 70, 90. Empty = no stars yet.
field.energyHint: Each player receives this much energy after they personally clear the NPC quest. It pays for hints — every hint costs 2, so the default 10 buys five. Running out never loses the stage, and wrong answers cost nothing. 0 means this stage has no hints.

picker.emptyHint: Only published questions can be assigned to a quest.

builder.subtitle: Assign a question to each quest. This stage grants map shard #{shard}.
builder.objectHint: Object key in the Phaser scene. Use only a-z, 0-9 and underscore.
builder.confirmDeleteStage: Delete this stage and all its quests? This cannot be undone.
builder.shardNote: Completing ALL quests grants the team Map Shard #{shard}
builder.pickQuestFirst: Pick a quest on the left, or type a new object key below.
builder.renameHint: Click to rename the object. Enter or click away to save.
builder.npcGateNote: Every stage opens at the NPC. All other quests stay locked until the player clears it — so everyone completes at least one quest, which is what earns the team its map shard.
builder.renameNpc: Click to rename the NPC — this is the name students see
builder.passScoreHint: Points needed to clear this quest. Defaults to the quest total ({total}) — leave it at the total and it follows along when you add or remove questions.

preview.subtitle: Content preview. Complete every quest to earn Map Shard #{shard}.
preview.noSceneYet: This page lists content, not graphics. Below is the exact quest and question order students will face — use “Play test” to see the real 2.5D scene.

stageBlocker.STAGE_TOO_FEW_QUESTS: A stage needs at least {required} quests; it has {actual}.
stageBlocker.STAGE_QUEST_QUESTION_DRAFT: Quest #{questOrder} ({questObject}) uses a question that is unpublished or deleted.
stageBlocker.STAGE_NO_ADVISOR: This stage has no NPC quest. Every stage needs exactly one — it is the gate that unlocks the rest.
stageBlocker.STAGE_SHARD_INDEX_TAKEN: Map shard #{shardIndex} is already granted by another stage.
stageBlocker.STAGE_QUEST_PASS_SCORE_TOO_HIGH: Quest #{questOrder} ({questObject}) needs {passScore} points to pass but only totals {totalPoints} — nobody can pass it.

game.keptPoints: No Map Shard this time. The skill points you earned are kept.

help.title: How to play
help.click: Click anywhere on the map to walk there.
help.keys: Or use W A D X, or the four arrow keys.
help.walkToQuest: Click an object to walk straight to it.
help.enterZone: A quest opens when your character touches an object's frame and stops there. Walking past it does not open anything.
help.boundary: Click past the edge of the map and your character walks that way until they reach the edge, then stops.
help.energy: Energy is yours alone, granted once you clear the NPC quest. Spend it on hints.

game.advisorLocked: Locked. Go and clear “{npc}” first — the NPC hands out the clue you need here.
game.energyMine: Your energy — personal, not shared with the team
game.claimBody: Tap the 📖 icon in the corner to open it any time.

cluebook.title: Clue book
cluebook.locked: Clear the NPC quest to receive the clue book

designer.title: Stage designer
designer.subtitle: Visual layout of “{name}”. Drag to place quests.
designer.noBackground: No background yet — upload one on the right

introVideo.title: Intro video
introVideo.hint: Plays while the stage loads in the background, then goes straight in. Leave it empty and students enter immediately, exactly as before.
introVideo.empty: No video — students go straight in, exactly as today. This is a valid choice.
introVideo.clock: The stage timer RUNS while it plays — it cannot be deferred, because one run belongs to the whole room. Keep it to 5–10 seconds.
introVideo.tooLong: {seconds} seconds long, so that is how much answering time students lose. Consider trimming it to 5–10 seconds.

designer.noQuest: No quests yet. Use “New quest” to add one.
designer.dragHint: Drag to place · double-click to edit details
designer.radiusHint: Players must step inside this radius before the questions open.
designer.confirmDelete: Delete this quest and all its attached questions?
designer.iconHint: Static image or GIF. Leave empty to use the default glow.
designer.resizeHint: Drag the corner handle to resize
designer.autoSave: everything saves automatically, no Save button needed
designer.pulseHint: The object grows and shrinks so players can tell it is interactive. Drag strength to 0 to stop it.
designer.characterHint: Drag the corner to fit the character to this map
designer.characterInherited: Inherited from the world's first stage. Resize here and this stage gets its own.
designer.characterNone: This world has no character with an uploaded sprite sheet yet, so there is nothing to size against.

cluebook.title: Clue book & NPC farewell
cluebook.intro: One moment in the game: the student answers the NPC's last question, and the conversation reaches its final step — the step that asks nothing.
cluebook.outro: What the NPC says while handing it over
cluebook.outroPlaceholder: Now, press onward with your journey and receive this handbook…
cluebook.outroHint: Shown on the final panel, right above the button. Leave it empty and the panel is just an icon and a button.
cluebook.outroTranscript: Show the text next to the player
cluebook.outroTranscriptHint: On by default — the opposite of a listening question. A listening question hides the text because reading it defeats the exercise; the NPC is not an exercise, and reading along while listening is how the words stick.
cluebook.bookTitleHint: Says whose handbook this is. Leave it empty and every stage falls back to the same generic label.
cluebook.bodyPlaceholder: The secrets the NPC hands over. Line breaks are kept exactly as you type them.
cluebook.bodyHint: Students reopen this from the 📖 icon any time after claiming it.
cluebook.bodyEmpty: No contents yet, so the 📖 icon will not appear at all. A button that never shows anything is worse than no button.
cluebook.notTranslated: Not translated into this language yet. Students reading in it will see whichever language does have text.

designer.spawnHint: Drag to set where players appear
designer.spawnDefault: Not set — players appear at the scene's default spot. Drag the character on the board and this stage gets its own.
designer.spawnOwn: Set for this stage only. Every stage has its own spawn point.
designer.spawnStuck: This spot is outside the walkable area. Players will be moved to the nearest walkable tile instead of appearing here.

walkarea.title: Walkable area
walkarea.empty: Nothing drawn — the character can walk anywhere on the map.
walkarea.summary: {count} shapes drawn. Outlines show faintly on the board.
walkarea.boardHint: Drawing the walkable area — dragging quests is paused. Press “Done” to go back.

hints.rect: Press and drag out a box.
hints.ellipse: Press and drag — the oval fits the box you drag.
hints.poly: Click each point. Return to the first point (the large dot) to close the shape.
hints.pick: Click a shape to select it, drag to move it.

walkarea.warnAllow: Outside every shape is still walkable, so a “walkable” shape changes nothing. Switch the toggle above to “Blocked”.
walkarea.keys: Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z redo · Backspace drops the last point · Esc deselects or cancels the shape being drawn · Delete removes the selected shape · hold Alt to leave the 20-unit grid
walkarea.testHint: Press the arrow keys or W A S D to walk. The ring at the feet is the COLLISION POINT — the exact point the game checks, not the middle of the body.
walkarea.testStuck: Standing outside the walkable area. Press a movement key and it will jump to the nearest spot.
walkarea.testNoRoom: Nowhere is walkable. Students entering this stage will be stuck where they stand.
walkarea.recipe: To add more: pick a tool and drag again on the board — draw as many shapes as you like. A path around a lake = one “Walkable” oval covering the area, then a small “Blocked” oval on top of the lake itself.

audio.title: Audio
audio.intro: Silent by default. A block only makes sound once you upload a file to it.

hints.ambient: Plays throughout the stage. Almost always wants looping — silence halfway through reads as broken audio.
hints.walk: Plays while the character moves, stops the moment they halt.
hints.idle: Plays while the character stands still. Leave empty for silence when standing.

audio.empty: No file — this block is silent.
audio.fromVideoHint: Shown only when the background is a video. Turn it on to take the music straight from that video's audio track.
audio.fromVideoOn: Background music is coming from the background video.
audio.fromVideoUnused: This file is NOT in use. Clear the checkbox above and it plays again.
audio.fromVideoNoRate: Speed and looping are decided by the video itself.
audio.confirmTitle: Use the video's sound as background music?
audio.confirmBody: The background video's sound will be used as the background music. The uploaded audio file will NOT be used — it stays right here, and clearing the checkbox brings it back.

designer.noIconHint: Leaving this empty is fine: the dashed box still drags and resizes to set the collision area. Students will see only the quest name, no artwork.
designer.stageCodeHint: The code from the content file, e.g. W1-S1. Fill it in and this stage's imported questions surface automatically when you build a quest. Leaving it empty is fine.
designer.questCodeHint: The code in the Questions sheet, e.g. W1-S1-Quest-01. Imported rows carrying it attach themselves here.

designer.title: Galaxy designer
designer.subtitle: Lay out the world selection screen students see.
designer.noBackground: No background yet — upload one on the right
designer.worldStoryHint: Shown in the popup when a student hovers this world.
designer.lockedHint: Students see a padlock and cannot enter. New worlds start locked.
designer.dragHint: Drag to place · drag the corner handle to resize
designer.ringHint: Turns the world into a round badge whose rim fills as shards are collected. Off: the artwork shows as-is.
designer.framesHint: Two panels on the map. They show the galaxy name and story until a student hovers a world, then that world's. Drag to place, drag the corner to resize.

designer.title: World lobby designer
designer.subtitle: Lay out the screen students see when they open this world.
designer.inheritHint: Empty means inherit from the galaxy. Upload a file here only where this world should differ.
designer.contentHint: Where text is drawn inside the background image. Drag the dashed frame on the preview, or type the numbers — percentages of the block, so it stays put when you resize the block.
designer.contentDrag: Drag to move the content frame
designer.blocksHint: Click a block on the preview to set its image, position and width.
designer.chapterImagesHint: Two images per chapter: the tile on the chapter row, and the backdrop behind the stage list that opens when a student clicks the chapter.
designer.contentPlainHint: Text fills this block — drag the block itself to place it. It wraps to fit, and ends with … when there is no room left.
designer.worldLevelHint: Free text shown in the lobby — “Easy”, “C2”, “3”. Empty falls back to the difficulty.

sample.characterLine: Lyra - Bright, charming, and fiercely loyal…

character.noneAvailable: No characters available for this world yet.

minimap.title: {chapter} — stages
minimap.empty: No stages published in this chapter yet.

play.resume: Continue “{stage}” — you have a run in progress

character.title: Characters
character.subtitle: Players pick one of these when they enter a world; Phaser draws it in the stage.
character.pickOne: Pick a character on the left to edit it.
character.name: Name
character.avatarHint: Shown on the character picker. The stage uses the action sprite sheets below, not this.
character.actionsHint: One strip image per action, frames laid out left to right. A single-frame image is fine — it just plays as a still.
character.confirmDelete: Delete this character? Its action sprite sheets go with it.
character.avatarCropHint: Click the avatar to pick the circular crop. The original file is kept.
character.cropHint: Drag the picture to move it, scroll or use the slider to zoom. The circle stays put.
character.framesHint: How many frames the strip holds
